description: 문서에서 참조하는 기존 측정 원본을 묶었다. 각 결과는 해당 실행 시점의 기록이며 새 측정이 아니다.

notes: Current production service; no JOIN replacement or cache added.
Separate JVM per DB, sequential urllib requests; 10 warmup + 30 measured requests.
HTTP values verify final behavior, not a controlled causal latency comparison between JVMs.
SQL captured after HTTP timing; logging settings restored.
Missing non-product tables temporarily copied as empty schemas for ddl-auto=validate.

notes: JDBC experiment, not HTTP latency. No production policy or implementation change.
Same indexed relationship schema in both modes; candidate maintains separate per-product counter.
Fixed closed-loop workers with persistent connections: read-only 4 readers; mixed 4 readers + 2 writers.
Two rounds per scenario; alternating mode order; 2s warmup + 8s measured per run.
Read latency includes JDBC query and full result consumption; write includes transaction and commit.
Mixed writes alternate register/cancel on one hot product with distinct synthetic users in FK-free copies.
No fixed arrival-rate/SLO claim; closed-loop results can hide queueing under external overload.
Counter backfill performed offline on disposable copies, not an online migration.
Prepared statements created per operation; connection startup and correctness audit excluded from timing.

notes: Offline deployment: do not restart the old aggregate-only writer after backfill.
LOCK TABLES protects the backfill; old/new writer coexistence is unsupported.
Source rows and indexes retained; product_like_count is intentionally persistent.
Counts/sums detect changes but are not cryptographic identity checks.
